baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_INVENTORY_AND_CONFIGURATION_DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md (FROZEN, 2026-09-20). Identity is stated rather than implied, and a reason shown to an operator comes from what was recorded.
baseline.engineering: main carries NXS-LOCAL-0354 at 3a62de7. 107 devices: 60 completed, 47 failed, all on the same recorded class.
baseline.observed: Two gaps found on the live deployment after NXS-LOCAL-0354 landed. First, the failure reason never resolves. The row renders 'Collection attempt failed - Recorded failure' for all 47 failed devices, although every one of them failed on the same recorded class. The comparison in InventoryScreen.tsx tests the whole terminal reason for exact equality with connect_failed, while the recorded value is a colon-delimited string whose first segment is that class and whose remainder carries transport detail. Measured in the database: split_part(terminal_reason, ':', 1) returns connect_failed for all 47 rows. Second, a name and an identifier never appear together. The inventory list and the device detail header show a hostname and no device identifier; JobLogsPanel shows target_device_id and no name. The identifier is deliberately left unmasked for replay-viewer sessions, so it is the stable handle that could correlate a screen with a log, but no screen presents both, and an operator reading a job log cannot tell which device on the inventory screen it belongs to.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Two bounded presentation fixes against a frozen design contract, with the data measured and the shape of the recorded reason already stated.

requirements: The class is derived from the recorded reason rather than matched against it whole, so a reason that carries detail after its class still resolves to that class
A reason whose class is not one the screen knows still reads as a recorded failure rather than as an invented category
A device name and its identifier appear together in at least one place an operator lands on from a log, and in at least one place they land on from the inventory
The identifier shown is the one the logs carry, unmodified: not shortened, not reformatted, not derived
No transport detail, port, address or credential reaches a list row through this change
risks: The recorded reason is a transport string. Derive the class from its leading segment and show only that; do not widen what reaches the row.

Under a replay-viewer session the name is a pseudonym while the identifier is not, and that is intended: the pair is what makes correlation possible. Do not mask the identifier to make them look consistent.
Do not touch the Draft or Failed filters. Both work, and an earlier claim against the Draft filter was withdrawn as a false finding.
